crunch_case_verdicts.case: Hartle-Hawking no-boundary proposal (J. Hartle & S. Hawking, 'Wave function of the Universe', Phys. Rev. D 28, 2960 (1983) — VERIFIED via APS/search: https://link.aps.org/doi/10.1103/PhysRevD.28.2960), including the modern contour controversy
crunch_case_verdicts.ledger: HH-1983 POSITION — Consumes: (1) the no-boundary history-class axiom: the amplitude is a path integral restricted to compact positive-definite 4-geometries whose only boundary is the argument 3-geometry — presented by HH themselves as a 'proposal' for the ground state, i.e. an axiom whose entire content is a state specification; (2) a complex integration contour, forced because the Euclidean gravitational action is unbounded below (conformal-factor problem) — and by the HH camp's OWN record the contour is chosen subject to criteria (convergence, WDW constraints, classicality prediction) that do not fix it uniquely: Halliwell & Hartle, 'Integration contours for the no-boundary wave function of the universe', Phys. Rev. D 41, 1815 (1990) — VERIFIED (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1990PhRvD..41.1815H); (3) minisuperspace truncation, measure and ordering choices. Produces: Psi[h,phi] — the initial state. FLT POSITION — Feldbrugge, Lehners & Turok, 'Lorentzian quantum cosmology', Phys. Rev. D 95, 103508 (2017), arXiv:1703.02076 — VERIFIED. Consumes: the Lorentzian lapse contour (0+,infinity), defended on propagator/causality grounds but contested by the HH side — still a defended choice — plus Picard-Lefschetz theory (machinery, no supplied content). Produces: an unambiguous saddle assignment whose semiclassical weighting is 'precisely the inverse of the famous Hartle-Hawking result' (abstract, verified), with tensor perturbations unsuppressed by a general theorem ('No smooth beginning for spacetime', PRL 119, 171301 (2017), arXiv:1705.00192 — VERIFIED), and a no-go: 'there is no choice of complex contour for the lapse which avoids this problem' ('No rescue for the no boundary proposal', PRD 97, 023509 (2018), arXiv:1708.05104 — VERIFIED; inverse-Gaussian perturbation distribution). Ledger reading: FLT's position is that the output state is a FUNCTION of the contour — the state-from-law content lives in the contour choice; under their preferred contour the construction yields no acceptable state at all. INTERMEDIATE HH-SIDE POSITION — Diaz Dorronsoro, Halliwell, Hartle, Hertog & Janssen, 'The real no-boundary wave function in Lorentzian quantum cosmology', PRD 96, 043505 (2017), arXiv:1705.05340 — VERIFIED: a different lapse contour, also Picard-Lefschetz-defined, recovers the real HH wave function — consuming the alternative contour choice; supporting chain item 'Damped perturbations in the no-boundary state', arXiv:1804.01102 (title sighted in verification sweep; perturbation damping restored by a further choice of the perturbations' initial condition). TERMINAL HH-SIDE POSITIONS — (a) Halliwell, Hartle & Hertog, 'What is the no-boundary wave function of the Universe?', PRD 99, 043526 (2019), arXiv:1812.01760 — VERIFIED, key sentence quoted from abstract: 'The wave function is given as a sum of specific saddle points of the dynamical theory that satisfy conditions of regularity on geometry and field' — the contour-integral definition is ABANDONED and the state is specified by direct saddle selection; (b) Di Tucci & Lehners, 'No-boundary proposal as a path integral with Robin boundary conditions', PRL 122, 201302 (2019) — VERIFIED: stable HH saddles are obtained from a manifestly convergent path integral if and only if 'a specific family of Robin boundary conditions' is imposed, explicitly glossed 'The price to pay is that the off-shell geometries do not start at a zero size' and interpreted as 'an initial state with Euclidean momentum'.
crunch_case_verdicts.evidence: Net: the state selection is traded for {history-class axiom + contour choice + measure} (1983), and the modern controversy's two SETTLED endpoints both carry the supplied condition on their face: either a hand-selected saddle class satisfying regularity conditions (HHH 2019) or a Robin boundary condition read as an initial state with the authors' own 'price to pay' language (Di Tucci-Lehners 2019). The same supplied content is thus bookable in the verified record as (i) a lapse contour, (ii) a saddle-selection rule, (iii) a Robin boundary condition — three TYPES, one content, interconverted by the participants themselves. Contour-contentfulness parallels the corpus's SJ-not-equal-BD predictive-contentfulness anchor (R10.2-prime): different contours yield different wave functions with different predictions (HH weighting vs its inverse), so the choice is physical, not notational. Owner's-test reading: this is the second branch realized in the literature's own hands — every apparent derivation revealed an equivalent choice somewhere else, stated as such by the authors. Honesty rider: the FLT no-go theorem (no lapse contour controls perturbations) is evidence of construction FAILURE under their definition, not of a trade; C-II gains from the succeeding-and-visibly-re-pricing constructions, not from the failed one. CII_audit.formalization_argument: No formulation-invariant scalar MEASURE of 'independent supplied content' exists across type-heterogeneous ledgers, on three grounds, one of them produced by this audit itself. (1) THE AUDIT'S OWN DATUM: one and the same supplied content is bookable, in the verified record, as a lapse-contour choice (FLT/DDHHHJ), a saddle-selection rule (HHH, PRD 99, 043526 (2019)), or a Robin boundary condition glossed as an initial state with Euclidean momentum (Di Tucci-Lehners, PRL 122, 201302 (2019)) — three types, one content, interconverted by the participants themselves. Any formulation-invariant measure must assign these equal size; but a contour is a point in an infinite-dimensional analytic space, a boundary condition a functional-parameter family, an axiom a discrete commitment — no shared unit exists, and equating them numerically is precisely the type-mixed integer the archive forbids (overseer-ruled 2026-08-04, origin/v4:VACUUM_CLUSTER_MAP.md line 59: 'if the integer is a type-mixed sum, don't ship an integer'; line 81: 'If anyone ever ships an integer, it must not be summed'). (3) WHAT SURVIVES — the archive-honoring residue: strict reduction IS certifiable without any measure, per exhibited reformulation map, as TYPED SUBSET-WITH-REMAINDER: the new inventory embeds type-respectingly into the old with at least one old entry unmatched and no new entries added. That is a partial order on typed inventories, not a scalar; verdicts are per-map REDUCTION / TRADE / NO-REDUCTION — exactly the archive's certified idiom (VACUUM_CLUSTER_MAP merge-tool reframe: 'REDUCTION / TRADE / NO-REDUCTION are declared readings', a declaration schema plus validator, never an adjudicator). The existence-half is therefore demoted from theorem-about-physics to organizing bookkeeping, per birth kill-condition (ii). But the trap does not take the whole candidate, because the owner's decisive question has an affirmative answer ON THE RECORD, and it rescues the location-half. Two named selections are physically meaningful, not dynamics-generated, and not definitional artifacts: (a) Micadei (Nat. Commun. 10:2456, corpus-VERIFIED, the R9-2′ O-converter): at experimentally FIXED dynamics, varying only initial correlations reverses the observed heat-flow direction — the two runs differ physically, the difference is demonstrably not in the dynamics, and no renaming of the law/state partition makes the thermometer readings agree; the selection's non-artifact status is certified by an observation, not by the definition. CIII_sweep.argument:
SWEEP: all 13 records classified (48 rows; the one ABSENCE-type priced entry, quantum_gravity_approaches/empirical_inputs/0, prices nothing of its own — it inherits G, hbar, c, Lambda, classified at their home rows; mathematical_foundational_structures declares itself empirically input-free, so its rows are theorem premises with ensemble AMBIGUOUS).

THE CORRELATION, TESTED. WANDERS rows: Lambda, primordial spectrum A_s/n_s, past hypothesis, cosmological principle, declared LCDM content, global factorization, dS vacuum choice (7 — all SINGLE-PREPARATION); CDT foliation, AQFT net assignment, statistical measure (3 — AMBIGUOUS, all global/framework-scale, patterning with the single-preparation cluster); Mori-Zwanzig projector (1 — MANY-PREPARATIONS, the counterexample). No many-preparation item anywhere in the 13 records has a CONTESTED law/state status: every many-preparation boundary-relativity in the corpus (MZ projector, system-bath split, material inputs) is conventionalized — indexed to a declared choice, all choices equivalent, no open problem riding on it. Every item whose law/state status is an open physical question (Lambda with its 120-orders problem premised on the vacuum-energy reading; the past hypothesis, promoted to law in the Mentaculus; the dS vacuum with SJ != BD; the global factorization with its unfrozen typing decision) is single-preparation or global. The forward direction (contested-as-physical implies single-preparation) holds with zero counterexamples. The reverse direction fails: T_CMB, H0, Omega_c, Omega_b h^2, tau are single-preparation and classify cleanly state-side — plain configuration data of the one preparation. The pattern the corpus actually supports: boundary-WANDERING = single-preparation AND law-position-eligible (items the formalism can be forced to write into its dynamics or axioms — a coefficient, a law-status candidate, a framework symmetry); single-preparation items that stay plain configuration data (temperatures, abundances, rates) never wander.

STRONGEST EVIDENCE — WITHIN-ITEM CONTRASTS (controlling for item-type confounds): the same formal object changes boundary behavior exactly when the ensemble collapses. (1) Vacuum: flat-space (many-prep, symmetry-fixed, uncontested) vs de Sitter (single-prep, SJ/BD/alpha-vacua contest, predictively contentful). (2) Factorization: lab system-bath split (many-prep, declared, conventionalized) vs global decomposition (single-prep, malformed in type-III, typing frozen nowhere). (3) Arrow: lab relaxation direction (many-prep, preparation-reversible per Micadei, cleanly state-side) vs cosmic arrow (single-prep, past hypothesis, law-status contested). (4) The condensed-matter record's own internal split, flagged in its own caveat: input-laden material parameters vs ensemble-invariant topological quantities (R_K) promoted to fundamental-constant status — the correlation running inside one domain.

THE CONDENSED-MATTER STRESS CASE, ADJUDICATED. Effective Hamiltonians/couplings ARE preparation-variable (materials) yet law-level within each material: the kill condition's second clause fires, verbatim, against the level-ABSOLUTE reading of C-III part B. The level-relative reading absorbs it — T_c is invariant across the within-material preparation ensemble (law at that level) and variable across the materials ensemble (input at the domain level) — and this absorption is NOT ad hoc: the identical structure recurs independently in engineered baths (open_quantum) and in the string-landscape relocation of all couplings to moduli vevs (core item D(i)), where postulating a vacua-ensemble is precisely an attempt to re-state-ify the couplings. So level-relativity is C-III's own prediction, instantiated at least twice in accessible physics.

UNFALSIFIABILITY, ANSWERED HONESTLY: yes, UNRESTRICTED level-addition makes C-III unfalsifiable — any law can be re-described as state relative to an imagined bigger ensemble (the landscape is the warning case: an ensemble postulated, not accessible), and if levels may be redrawn freely, 'law at level L = invariant over level-L preparations' collapses into a definition and part B's correlation becomes analytic — the charter's vocabulary trap. C-III retains empirical content only under two declarable anchors: (i) ACCESSIBILITY — a level counts only if its preparation ensemble is independently accessible (materials, engineered baths, lab subsystem carvings qualify; postulated landscapes do not); (ii) CONTEST — 'boundary-ambiguity' must mean contested-as-physical, marked non-circularly by predictive contentfulness or a standing open problem riding on the choice (SJ != BD; the 120-orders mismatch), not mere formal relocatability (which the many-prep MZ projector also has). With both anchors declared, part B survives as a falsifiable one-way claim and the corpus confirms it; without them, it is unfalsifiable and should be scored as vocabulary. Part A independently remains vocabulary-adjacent (kill condition ii, not this sweep's charge); part B's surviving content is the refined correlation, not the definition.

VERDICT ON THE OWNER'S KILL CONDITION: both disjuncts are instantiable from the corpus against the STRONG form (biconditional, level-absolute) of part B — clause 1 by T_CMB/H0/Omega_c, clause 2 by the condensed-matter inputs — so the strong form, including the conceptual pass's 'exactly where' phrasing, is KILLED. The WEAK form (one-way, level-indexed with accessible ensembles, contest-anchored) survives every counterexample hunted in both directions. Hence HOLDS-WITH-EXCEPTIONS. Two corrections to the conceptual pass's part-B presentation follow from the sweep: G does not belong on the wanderer list (see counterexamples — the {G, Lambda} asymmetry in fact strengthens C-III), and the four-example base of part B is replaced by a full-corpus tally: 11 wanderers (7 single-prep, 3 global-ambiguous, 1 many-prep-conventionalized), 0 many-preparation contested items, 5 single-preparation clean-state exceptions.
